## Setup

```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)
library(hrbrthemes) #point density charts
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)

transects <- st_read(here("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "transectsDS") 
transects$TCC <- as.numeric(transects$TCC)
transects$TRT_TYPE[is.na(transects$TRT_TYPE)] <- "Untreated"

plots <- st_read(here("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg"), layer = "allplotsDS")
```

# Transect Sampling Summary Table

```{r}
transect_summary <- transects %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%          
  group_by(Incid_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transects   = n_distinct(Transect_ID),
    n_entering    = sum(type == "entering", na.rm = TRUE)/10,
    n_exiting     = sum(type == "exiting", na.rm = TRUE)/10,
    n_control     = sum(type == "control", na.rm = TRUE)/10,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Incid_Name)


transect_summary %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Fire Name", "Total", "Entering", "Exiting", "Control"),
    caption = "Number of sampled transects within each fire",
    align = "lcccc"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) 
```

## Point Density of Transect Characteristics by Treatment Type

```{r}
#Topography
p1 <- ggplot(data=transects, aes(x=northness, group=TRT_TYPE, fill=TRT_TYPE)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.4) +
    theme_minimal()
p1

p2 <- ggplot(data=transects, aes(x=eastness, group=TRT_TYPE, fill=TRT_TYPE)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.4) +
    theme_minimal()
p2

p4

    theme_minimal()
p5

p6 <- ggplot(data=transects, aes(x=PRCP, group=TRT_TYPE, fill=TRT_TYPE)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.4) +
    theme_minimal()
p6

#Fuels
p8 <- ggplot(data=transects, aes(x=TCC, group=TRT_TYPE, fill=TRT_TYPE)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.4) +
    theme_minimal()
p8

#Response
p12 <- ggplot(data=transects, aes(x=rdnbr, group=TRT_TYPE, fill=TRT_TYPE)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.4) +
    theme_minimal()
p12

p13 <- ggplot(data=transects, aes(x=rdnbr, group=TRT_TYPE, fill=TRT_TYPE)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.4) +
    theme_minimal()
p13
```

## Point Density of Plot Characteristics by Treatment Type

```{r}
## Point Density of Plot Characteristics by Treatment Type
vars_to_plot <- c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMAX", "PRCP", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Rearrangement", 
                  "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", 
                  "prop_extent_treated", "TCC", "mean_rdnbr")

plot_list <- map(vars_to_plot, ~{
  ggplot(data = plots, aes(x = .data[[.x]])) +
    geom_density(adjust = 1.5, alpha = .4) +
    labs(x = .x) +
    theme_minimal()
})

walk(plot_list, print)
```

# Copy over from regressions code, need to update

## Transects by Type in each Fire and Starting Severity

```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Build abbreviation lookup once, outside the pipe
fire_abbrevs <- jones_df %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  distinct(Incid_Name) %>% 
  arrange(Incid_Name) %>% 
  mutate(abbrev = abbreviate(Incid_Name, minlength = 3)) %>% 
  tibble::deframe()  

jones_df %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  count(Starting_Sev, Incid_Name, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    n = n / 10,
    Starting_Sev = factor(Starting_Sev, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = c("control", "entering", "exiting")),
    Incid_Name = fire_abbrevs[Incid_Name]  # swap to abbreviation before pivoting
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Incid_Name,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Starting_Sev, Type) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total = rowSums(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric)))
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::group_split(Starting_Sev) %>% 
  purrr::iwalk(~ {
    cat("\n\n###", as.character(unique(.x$Starting_Sev)), "\n\n")
    print(
      knitr::kable(
        dplyr::select(.x, -Starting_Sev),
        format = "pipe"
      )
    )
  })


# Print the key once, after all three tables
cat("\n\n**Key:**", paste(names(fire_abbrevs), fire_abbrevs, sep = " = ", collapse = "; "), "\n\n")
```

## Points by Treatment Type in each EVT Group and Starting Severity

```{r, results = 'asis'}
#Table of Transects by Type in each EVT Group
jones_df %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  count(Starting_Sev, EVT, Treated) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    n = n,
    Starting_Sev = factor(Starting_Sev, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = EVT,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Starting_Sev, Treated) %>% 
  dplyr::group_split(Starting_Sev) %>% 
  purrr::iwalk(~ {
    cat("\n\n###", as.character(unique(.x$Starting_Sev)), "\n\n")
    print(
      knitr::kable(
        dplyr::select(.x, -Starting_Sev),
        format = "pipe"
      )
    )
  })
```
